## Debug faster with Relevant Moments and Multi-Session Summary in Session Replay[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/readme/2026-11\#debug-faster-with-relevant-moments-and-multi-session-summary-in-session-replay)

![The Session Replay sessions list with the Summary of the last 6 sessions panel open.](https://docs.luciq.ai/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1627791424-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FX5AT2gAek6Hb4IQeMXHI%252Fuploads%252Fgit-blob-f98f532eaa68f84222db94905b4a8f9e41e54955%252Fsession-replay-multi-session-summary.png%3Falt%3Dmedia&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=6f0d0d6f428aba6f87509d65f8d002c8&sv=3)

#### Summary[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/readme/2026-11\#summary)

See the moments that matter in a session without watching the whole recording, or get one summary across up to 10 filtered sessions to spot patterns faster.

#### What's new?[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/readme/2026-11\#whats-new)

- **Relevant Moments**: Get a quick view of the relevant moments in a single session, right from the sessions list, so you can jump straight to what's important.

- **Multi-Session Summary**: Filter your sessions as usual, then click **Generate summary** to get one summary across up to 10 sessions at once.


#### Why this matters?[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/readme/2026-11\#why-this-matters)

- You spend less time watching sessions one by one and more time fixing.

- You can spot patterns across sessions instead of judging an issue from a single recording, and get to the root cause faster.


[Documentation](https://docs.luciq.ai/product-guides-and-integrations/product-guides/session-replay)
